name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. '_11' is spell ID 0x11 (=17), a meaningful domain ID that must be preserved. '_stage_a' is a descriptive suffix (a letter, not an address residue) marking this as the first of three structurally-identical stat-boost stage handlers (0x11 stage_a/AP, 0x12 stage_b/DP, 0x13 stage_c/speed) registered consecutively in the dispatch table @ 0x51D01. Name is consistent with both siblings; renaming one of the triplet would break the consistent scheme. No hex suffix matching any address.
purpose: Spell dispatch handler for spell_id 0x11 (AP-boost spell): a thin wrapper that resets the AoE target counter, charges caster MP, and delegates to the AP-boost worker.
logic_summary: Sets data_fd2_battle_spell_aoe_count_and_fx_queue_idx (@ 0x53ec4) to 0, calls fd2_deduct_caster_mp(caster, 0x12) -- charging MP via cost-table index 0x12 rather than 0x11 (intentional, mirrors the 0x12 stage_b wrapper) -- then calls fd2_cast_ap_boost_spell(caster, n_tgt, tgt_arr) (worker @ 0x22721). Returns void. Single basic block, cyclomatic complexity 1. Reached only indirectly via the spell dispatch table entry 0x11 (0x51D01 + 0x44 = 0x51D45), no direct callers.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_cast_spell_11_stage_a(int caster, int n_tgt, uint8 *tgt_arr)

params.name: caster
params.semantics: Caster unit ID; passed through to fd2_deduct_caster_mp and the AP-boost worker.
params.reason: Clear, domain-appropriate, matches the sibling wrappers' convention in this file; no address residue. (Ghidra live signature uses the more verbose caster_unit_id, but the src name caster is clear and consistent file-wide.)

params.name: n_tgt
params.semantics: Number of targets; forwarded unchanged to the AP-boost worker.
params.reason: Clear and consistent with sibling handlers; no address residue.

params.name: tgt_arr
params.semantics: Pointer to the target unit-ID array; forwarded unchanged to the AP-boost worker.
params.reason: Clear and consistent with sibling handlers; no address residue.

comment_original_issue: Function had no per-function comment block -- only the shared section header '=== Stat boost wrappers (id 0x11-0x13) ===' above it. The non-obvious detail that MP is deducted using cost-table index 0x12 (not 0x11) was undocumented in src, while sibling families in the file each carry per-function comments.
notes: Decompilation matches src body byte-for-byte. Verified dispatch-table index: table @ 0x51D01, entry 0x11 at offset 0x44 (0x51D45) = 0x226EA (read_memory dword = ea 26 02 00). Global symbol name in Ghidra (data_fd2_battle_spell_aoe_count_and_fx_queue_idx @ 0x53ec4, 30 xrefs) is byte-identical to the src symbol. The 0x12-vs-0x11 MP cost mapping is genuine (sibling 0x12 stage_b also uses 0x12; 0x13 stage_c uses 0x13). Ghidra plate already accurate and consistent with refined understanding, so left unchanged. Commit staged only src/spell/spell.c and this shard.
